title: A batch gate held for timing out twice retries on its own
description: Runs the real gate over ports whose clock the case controls: a hold raised because the gate timed out twice on a tip reruns that tip after its 30-minute cool-off without main moving and verifies it, master status attention names the hold and its reason while it stands, and a gate held for a failing case still waits for main to move.

steps.name: a timeout hold retries its tip; a failing-case hold waits for main
